BS2BG 1.1.2 - third-party notices

This self-contained Windows x64 application image bundles the following components.
Their license texts are shipped inside the image at the paths named below.

Bundled runtime
---------------
Eclipse Adoptium Temurin-25.0.4.1+1 (Eclipse Temurin JDK, jlink'd runtime) 25.0.4.1+1-LTS
  License: GNU General Public License v2.0 with the Classpath Exception
  Notices: runtime/legal/<module>/ (LICENSE, ASSEMBLY_EXCEPTION, ADDITIONAL_LICENSE_INFO and third-party .md files per JDK module)
OpenJFX (Gluon JavaFX Windows x64 JMODs) 25.0.4
  License: GNU General Public License v2.0 with the Classpath Exception
  Notices: runtime/legal/{javafx.base,javafx.graphics,javafx.controls,javafx.fxml}/

Application libraries (app/lib)
-------------------------------
commons-io-2.6.jar (commons-io:commons-io:2.6)
  Notices: notices/commons-io-2.6/LICENSE.txt
  Notices: notices/commons-io-2.6/NOTICE.txt
jackson-core-3.1.5.jar (tools.jackson.core:jackson-core:3.1.5)
  License: The Apache Software License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt)
  Notices: notices/jackson-core-3.1.5/LICENSE
  Notices: notices/jackson-core-3.1.5/NOTICE
juniversalchardet-2.1.0.jar (com.github.albfernandez:juniversalchardet:2.1.0)

  License: GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE, version 3 (GPL-3.0) (http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl.txt)
